rationale: The landing md/given-typing.md#claim-given.typing.configurations directly introduces configuration typing with a fixed final environment. The given.typing.configurations unit links its typing and execution prerequisites and now uses public framed completion. Final environments describe pre-exit locals; finished execution retains no frame. Counted completion uses n+1, while the n-step observation retains the final-environment witness. No implicit destructor obligation is added. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter. Inserted rootedness definitions and checked examples move later source positions. Unchanged target passages were relocated by exact-byte comparison; revised invariant passages and new links were reviewed directly. All added conceptual links point backward after moving Shared pending-liveness immediately after ordinary liveness.
limitations: Author editorial self-review. Extraction and byte ranges do not establish clarity by themselves. Earlier unchanged passages retain the prior review after exact-input comparison. Future notes remain nonnormative.
